description: Rust CLI/TUI tool for managing Claude Code configuration profiles

stories.title: Project skeleton and domain layer
stories.description: Initialize Rust project with Cargo.toml, core structs (Profile, ClaudeSettings, ConfigPaths), error types, and atomic file write helper
acceptanceCriteria: cargo init creates project with name claude-profile
Cargo.toml includes all dependencies (clap, serde, toml, dirs, url, thiserror, anyhow, chrono, fs4 optional)
src/profile.rs defines Profile struct with serde derive and [settings] section
src/settings.rs defines ClaudeSettings struct matching actual settings.json with #[serde(flatten)] extra
src/config.rs defines ConfigPaths with XDG resolution and CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR override
src/error.rs defines unified error type with thiserror
Atomic write helper exists and creates temp file + renames
cargo build compiles with zero errors

stories.title: Core switch logic - backup, switch, rollback
stories.description: Implement backup creation, profile switching (full-file replacement), rollback, file locking, and dirty check
acceptanceCriteria: backup_current() copies settings.json to backups/ with timestamp
switch_to() validates, acquires file lock, backs up, writes profile atomically, updates active_profile marker
rollback() restores most recent backup and updates active_profile marker
File locking with fs4 prevents concurrent switches
Dirty check warns if settings.json changed since last backup (requires --force)
All switch operations are atomic (temp file + rename)
Hook entry is preserved/re-added after every switch

stories.title: Profile validation and import
stories.description: Implement profile validation (URL syntax, API key format) and import from existing settings-*.json files
acceptanceCriteria: validate_profile() checks TOML parse success
base_url validated as valid URL syntax using url crate
API key format validated (sk- prefix check)
import command converts settings-*.json to Profile TOML preserving all keys
#[serde(flatten)] extra captures unknown settings.json keys
Validation returns specific error messages for each failure type

stories.title: CLI interface
stories.description: Implement CLI commands: list, switch, rollback, import, validate, show, add, remove with clap derive
acceptanceCriteria: claude-profile list shows all profiles with active marker
claude-profile switch <name> performs switch with output confirmation
claude-profile switch --dry-run shows preview without modifying files
claude-profile rollback restores previous config
claude-profile import <file> --name <name> converts JSON to TOML
claude-profile validate <name> checks without switching
claude-profile show <name> displays profile with masked API key
claude-profile add <name> creates new profile template
claude-profile remove <name> deletes after confirmation
All commands return appropriate exit codes (0 success, 1 error)

stories.title: TUI interface
stories.description: Implement interactive menu with ratatui for profile browsing and switching
acceptanceCriteria: claude-profile tui opens interactive menu
Arrow keys navigate profile list
Preview pane shows selected profile details
Enter triggers switch with confirmation dialog
q/Esc exits cleanly
Terminal resize handled gracefully
Renders correctly in 80x24 terminal

stories.title: Hook integration
stories.description: Implement informational hook that detects switch intent and instructs user
acceptanceCriteria: claude-profile hook install adds UserPromptSubmit hook entry
claude-profile hook uninstall removes hook entry
Hook installation is idempotent
Hook detects 'switch to <profile>' pattern in prompt
Hook responds with instructions (CLI command + restart) without modifying settings.json
Hook script is copied to ~/.claude/hooks/

stories.title: Testing and verification
stories.description: Unit tests, integration tests, benchmarks for cold start and binary size
acceptanceCriteria: cargo test passes all unit tests
Profile parse roundtrip test passes
Backup and rollback test passes
Validation rejects invalid URLs and API keys
XDG paths respected on all platforms (mocked)
Cold start benchmark < 100ms
Binary size < 5MB (default build) or < 15MB (with all features)
